audit_scale.pass_rule: each criterion >=1; total >=13/16; any 0 is fail

specimens.name: WRASAL laboratory
specimens.brief: A calibration bench with active KORA-7, retired fixture, service tags, and one operator documenting a material test.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 50mm, f/8, archival/technical, low-key, cool diagnostic blue only at active test node.

specimens.name: WRASAL technical instrument
specimens.brief: KORA-7 Datum Instrument, Rev C, 286x94x42mm, anodized aluminum and PVD titanium, datum rail, serial plate, contact polish, replaceable battery door.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 100mm macro, f/11, raking light, measured three-quarter, no floating UI.

specimens.name: WRASAL production terminal
specimens.brief: TAKE/04 cinematic production terminal, Rev F, physical toggles, smoked glass, cable strain relief, gaffer residue, current and superseded routing sheets.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 50mm, f/5.6, studio rack context, white labels, gold only on selected route.

specimens.name: WRASAL architectural environment
specimens.brief: Buildable raw concrete and travertine research courtyard, botanicals, drainage, realistic shallow water, one human scale anchor, service access visible.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 24mm, f/11, strict perspective, natural late-day light, no luxury staging.

specimens.name: WRASAL human portrait
specimens.brief: A specific operator with stable SCCT identity anchors, real pores and melanin variation, asymmetry, practical workwear, looking toward a calibrated instrument in use.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 85mm, f/2.8, soft key/cool edge/local warm reflection, context retained.

specimens.name: WRASAL cultural performance scene
specimens.brief: A community performance in a real cultural space: musicians, audience, sound routing, locally meaningful naming/language/context, clothing with believable physics.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 35mm, f/4, motivated practicals, movement and relationship over costume spectacle.

specimens.name: WRASAL archival/forensic image
specimens.brief: Indexed evidence photograph of a decommissioned control module: accession card, capped port, dust shadow, former mount, comparison datum, uncertainty recorded.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 50mm, f/11, forensic flat light, high information density, archival gray metadata.

specimens.name: WRASAL time-memory artifact
specimens.brief: One fixed architectural datum shown as material state stack for 2012/2018/2024/2026/2032 through revision plates, removed mounts, vegetation, and planned construction—not nostalgia filter.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 35mm locked viewpoint, f/8, layered but optically plausible presentation.

specimens.name: WRASAL vehicle technical documentation
specimens.brief: Serviceable vehicle subsystem with load path, access panel, fasteners, tire/contact evidence, revision plate, operator scale, and diagnostic point.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 24mm documentation plus 100mm detail, neutral measured light, no concept-car impossible surfaces.

specimens.name: WRASAL unknown recovered artifact
specimens.brief: Recovered object on chain-of-custody table; function uncertain, partial operation, repair evidence, provenance gaps, calibrated scale, careful uncertainty labels.
specimens.camera_and_mode: 85mm or 100mm macro, low-key forensic light, no invented mythology or decorative glow.
